title: Full integrand coefficients do not cover every compatible field
statement: Parent broadens to ALL 15 coefficients of homogeneous quartic H on Sym(2). Fourth-tensor symmetry exchanges matrix and rank-one test slots, motivating 3x3 Hessian H_doubleprime(a^2,ab,b^2) PSD for all(a,b) and proposed 9x9 Gram on binary quadratics times 3 matrix coordinates. Matrix Fejer–Riesz supports univariate matrix-SOS ancestry; homogenization/real-Gram exact receiving and strict actual-field witness are still obligations. This is a working claimed lossless integrand cone, NOT a new certified separation. Actual tested fields are scalar Hessians in finite Fourier family with mean/domain transform, distinct from unrestricted 2x2gradient Morrey problem; whole cone coverage is not whole field coverage. Supplied 144-iteration log has minimum objective~ -1.38e-11, most negative Gram eigenvalue~-2.15e-9, each smallest covariance eigenvalue<=1.73e-6 and domain determinant approaching3.70e-8. Captured values do not reach parent strict-negative cutoff -1e-7; degeneracy is a diagnostic explanation, not structural theorem. No exact rational cone certificate, strict compatible counterexample or universal no-go. Later completed final supplies separate ANALYTIC quantitative globalROC sextic extension,conditional strong-Hessian-QC extension and EVERY-eta family equivalence,with exact source receipts. It does not retroactively certify earlier numerical fits,prove source HessianQC,replace scalar-Hessian compatibility by unrestricted matrix fields or establish separation. New operation scopes live in N1489/N1490; earlier working search and execution-identity uncertainty retained.
